protocol: Thirty independent single-patient observation-to-EZN fits v1
scope: Each patient is fit independently. No population model, cross-patient parameter sharing, cross-patient training, or population EZ frequency is used.

optimization.selection: maximum Stan lp__ using only that patient's observation likelihood and priors

primary_ezn_score: within-patient MAP x0; larger is more epileptogenic
truth_policy: EZ/PZ is forbidden until every patient's prediction CSV has been written and hashed.
aggregation: Across-patient arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1); report n for every metric.
claim_boundary: Synthetic VEP cohort engineering benchmark of independent patient fits; not a population model, posterior analysis, clinical validation, or deployment evidence.
